book.title: SLEEF 3.9.0: the scalar u10 error bounds
book.description: Four documented SLEEF u10 claims, each stated as a 1.0 ULP bound on the returned value, carried as measured rows against an MPFR 4.2.2 reference at 256 bits. The rows measure a finite sample; the library's own claim is uniform. The ULP denominator is the spacing at the correctly rounded value, floored at the smallest subnormal, which is the definition SLEEF's own tester (countULPdp) uses.

provenance.measurement: wider-validation/sleef/driver.c, linked against libsleef.a; reference MPFR 4.2.2 at 256 bits, 60 significant digits printed
provenance.ulp_definition: SLEEF's src/common/testerutil.c countULPdp: |result - exact| divided by the binary64 spacing at the correctly rounded value, floored at 4.9406564584124654e-324
provenance.data: one CSV per function under data/, generated by wider-validation/gen_inputs.py and measured by the driver

registrations.sentence: These functions evaluate the sine function of a value in a. The error bound of the returned value is 1.0 ULP.
registrations.scope: Sleef_sin_u10 and Sleef_sinf_u10; the section heading states 'sine functions with 1.0 ULP error bound'

registrations.sentence: These functions return the value of e raised to a. The error bound of the returned value is 1.0 ULP.
These functions return the natural logarithm of a. The error bound of the returned value is 1.0 ULP.
registrations.scope: Sleef_log_u10 and Sleef_logf_u10; the section heading states 'natural logarithmic functions with 1.0 ULP error bound'

registrations.sentence: These functions return the value as specified in the C99 specification of erf and erff functions. The error bound of the returned value is 1.0 ULP.
registrations.scope: Sleef_erf_u10 and Sleef_erff_u10; the section heading states 'error functions with 1.0 ULP error bound'
